build_SO2_Convolution: build a python module to create an SO2 convolution layer for spherical harmonic features with configurable m orders
build_SO2_Linear: build a python module to create an SO2 linear layer that processes spherical harmonic coefficients by m order
build_SO2_m_Conv_Block: build a python module to create an SO2 convolution block using block-diagonal GEMM for faster tensor core utilization
refactor_SO2_Convolution_to_block: refactor an existing SO2_Convolution to use SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock or SO2_Conv2_InternalBlock for improved performance
review_SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock: review the SO2_Conv1_WithRadialBlock class that combines radial MLP embeddings with block-diagonal SO2 convolution for m greater than 0
